about: compiler/objfmt: pure-Ergo DoD relocatable ELF64 & Mach-O64 object writer, structural decoders, and baseline x86_64/arm64 machine-code encoders.

mutants.name: objfmt-buf-u32-byte-order
mutants.rule: U32 writes 32-bit integers in little-endian byte order.

mutants.name: objfmt-buf-u64-hi-word
mutants.from:
w.U32(uint32(x & uint64(0xffffffff)))
	w.U32(uint32(x >> uint64(32)))
mutants.to:
w.U32(uint32(x & uint64(0xffffffff)))
	w.U32(uint32(0))
mutants.rule: U64 writes both low and high 32-bit words of a 64-bit integer.

mutants.name: objfmt-buf-strpool-dedup
mutants.rule: StrPool.Intern deduplicates identical strings to the same dense ID.

mutants.name: objfmt-obj-bss-align-dropped
mutants.from: let off = AlignUpUint64(o.BssSize, align)
mutants.to: let off = o.BssSize
mutants.rule: AllocBss must align each reservation offset to the requested alignment.

mutants.name: objfmt-obj-reloc-extent-skip
mutants.rule: ValidateObject must reject relocations whose patch extent overflows the target section.

mutants.name: objfmt-elf64-machine-wrong
mutants.from:
case ArchARM64:
		ElfMachineAArch64
mutants.to:
case ArchARM64:
		ElfMachineX86_64
mutants.rule: ELF64 header e_machine must be EM_AARCH64 (183) when targeting ArchARM64.

mutants.name: objfmt-elf64-gnu-stack-exec
mutants.from: elfSectionMeta{nameOff: shNameOffs[5], shType: ShtProgbits, flags: uint64(0), offset: noteOff, size: uint64(0), link: uint32(0), info: uint32(0), addrAlign: uint64(1), entSize: uint64(0)},
mutants.to: elfSectionMeta{nameOff: shNameOffs[5], shType: ShtProgbits, flags: ShfExecInstr, offset: noteOff, size: uint64(0), link: uint32(0), info: uint32(0), addrAlign: uint64(1), entSize: uint64(0)},
mutants.rule: .note.GNU-stack must have sh_flags = 0 for a non-executable stack.

mutants.name: objfmt-elf64-symtab-shinfo
mutants.from: elfSectionMeta{nameOff: shNameOffs[8], shType: ShtSymtab, flags: uint64(0), offset: symOff, size: symSize, link: ElfSecStrtab, info: firstGlobal, addrAlign: uint64(8), entSize: uint64(24)},
mutants.to: elfSectionMeta{nameOff: shNameOffs[8], shType: ShtSymtab, flags: uint64(0), offset: symOff, size: symSize, link: ElfSecStrtab, info: if firstGlobal == uint32(999999) { firstGlobal } else { uint32(1) }, addrAlign: uint64(8), entSize: uint64(24)},
mutants.rule: .symtab sh_info must equal the index of the first non-local symbol.

mutants.name: objfmt-elf64-locals-after-globals
mutants.rule: ELF64 .symtab must place all STB_LOCAL symbols strictly before globals.

mutants.name: objfmt-elf64-plt32-addend
mutants.rule: x86_64 PLT32 ELF64 RELA relocations must subtract the 4-byte displacement size from addend.

mutants.name: objfmt-elf64-rela-link-wrong
mutants.from: elfSectionMeta{nameOff: shNameOffs[6], shType: ShtRela, flags: ShfInfoLink, offset: relaTextOff, size: relaTextSize, link: ElfSecSymtab, info: ElfSecText, addrAlign: uint64(8), entSize: uint64(24)},
mutants.to: elfSectionMeta{nameOff: shNameOffs[6], shType: ShtRela, flags: ShfInfoLink, offset: relaTextOff, size: relaTextSize, link: ElfSecNull, info: ElfSecText, addrAlign: uint64(8), entSize: uint64(24)},
mutants.rule: .rela.text sh_link must reference the .symtab section index.

mutants.name: objfmt-elf64-arm64-call26-wrong
mutants.rule: ARM64 RelocCall and RelocJump must emit R_AARCH64_CALL26 and R_AARCH64_JUMP26 respectively.

mutants.name: objfmt-macho64-magic-wrong
mutants.from: w.U32(MachoMagic64)
mutants.to: w.U32(uint32(0xfeedface))
mutants.rule: Mach-O64 header must begin with MH_MAGIC_64 (0xfeedfacf).

mutants.name: objfmt-macho64-nsect-value-missing-secaddr
mutants.from: nValue = secAddrs[int(sec)] + o.SymValue[symIdx]
mutants.to: nValue = o.SymValue[symIdx]
mutants.rule: Mach-O64 nlist_64 n_value for N_SECT symbols is segment-relative (section addr + offset).

mutants.name: objfmt-macho64-locals-order
mutants.rule: Mach-O64 nlist_64 symbol table must emit local symbols before external symbols.

mutants.name: objfmt-macho64-arm64-page21-pcrel
mutants.rule: ARM64_RELOC_PAGE21 must be marked PC-relative (r_pcrel = 1).

mutants.name: objfmt-macho64-zerofill-flag
mutants.from: flags:     MachoSecZerofill,
mutants.to: flags:     MachoSecRegular,
mutants.rule: __DATA,__bss section_64 must carry S_ZEROFILL (0x1).

mutants.name: objfmt-decode-elf-skip-strtab-nul
mutants.rule: DecodeELF64 must reject SHT_STRTAB sections lacking leading or trailing NUL bytes.

mutants.name: objfmt-decode-elf-skip-local-order
mutants.rule: DecodeELF64 must reject local symbols placed at or after .symtab sh_info.

mutants.name: objfmt-decode-macho-skip-reloc-bounds
mutants.rule: DecodeMachO64 must reject relocations whose extent exceeds the owning section size.

mutants.name: objfmt-amd64-rel32-disp
mutants.from: a.Code.Put32(pc, uint32(target-(pc+4)))
mutants.to: a.Code.Put32(pc, uint32(target-pc))
mutants.rule: FinishAmd64 must patch 32-bit branch displacements relative to pc + 4.

mutants.name: objfmt-amd64-rex-w-dropped
mutants.from: emitRex(&a.Code, true, src, uint8(0), dst)
mutants.to: emitRex(&a.Code, false, src, uint8(0), dst)
mutants.rule: 64-bit MovRR must emit REX.W.

mutants.name: objfmt-amd64-lea-rip-modrm
mutants.from: emitModRM(&a.Code, uint32(0), dst, uint8(5))
mutants.to: emitModRM(&a.Code, uint32(0), dst, uint8(4))
mutants.rule: LeaRipSym must encode ModRM [RIP + disp32] (mod=0, rm=5).

mutants.name: objfmt-arm64-branch-imm26
mutants.from: let dispWords = (target - pc) / 4
mutants.to: let dispWords = target - pc
mutants.rule: FinishArm64 must scale branch offsets by instruction word size (4 bytes).

mutants.name: objfmt-arm64-prologue-stp
mutants.from: let imm7 = uint32(0x7e)
mutants.to: let imm7 = uint32(0x02)
mutants.rule: A64Prologue must pre-decrement SP by 16 bytes (imm7 = -2 = 0x7e).
